review.report: AK-puzzle-pictures R1/V1, pack-194. Derived from the generated square by flattening the outer 5% frame to the median of the outer 1% ring (RGB [204, 208, 212]), then BOX downsampling to 20x20, one colour per board cell, alpha composited over white; re-running the derive reproduces the committed pixel with zero differing cells (S1, S5, S6, K1, K6). Filled 139/400 by the fixed rule (alpha over white, Y = 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B on 0-255 sRGB, Y < 128), inside the 100-180 band; one line-logic solution reaching this fill set (S2-S4, K2, K3). Pixel look: the silhouette still reads at 20x20 as a thick square ring with a separate solid square block seated in its opening, fused to the ring's right arm (AES.P1, K4). No per-puzzle subject class is assigned or recorded. No series (SS1 none). License: Cheaper Inference terms.
